slides.headline: POV: buyers arrive Saturday
slides.body: What they notice before they say a word.
slides.say: Picture this. Buyers are walking up to your front door.

slides.headline: They judge the outside
slides.body: Sweep the path. Clean the door. Fix the light.
slides.say: They judge your home before they step inside. Sweep the path and clean the front door.

slides.headline: Open every curtain
slides.body: Light makes every room feel bigger.
slides.say: Open every curtain. Light makes every room feel bigger.

slides.headline: Fresh air, not air freshener
slides.body: Open the windows an hour before.
slides.say: Open the windows an hour before. Fresh air beats any spray.
